Hi Rishi / Marissa - below is a concise PII handling confirmation you can send to Acme. Attaching the SOC2 summary as requested.

Short confirmation (pasteable to procurement):
"Redwood Inference handles prompts, outputs, and telemetry according to customer-configurable policies. For our hosted API, prompts and outputs are persisted by default for up to 30 days to support debugging, quality monitoring, and safety investigations; customers may opt out of storing prompts/outputs by enabling the 'no_store' privacy flag or by using our Dedicated/Private deployment options where customer-controlled retention policies apply. Telemetry (request IDs, latency, token counts) is retained for operational monitoring and billing and is kept for a configurable period (default 90 days) unless otherwise contracted. All data in transit and at rest is encrypted; customers can configure regional residency (us-east1, us-west2, eu-west1) and integrate with customer-managed KMS for Dedicated/Private deployments. SOC2 Type II report and DPA are available upon request (see attached SOC2 summary)."

Detailed bullets (for procurement/security intake):
- Default hosted behavior: 
  - Prompts & outputs: persisted up to 30 days by default for hosted API to support debugging, safety, and model quality.
  - Telemetry/logs (request ids, latency, token counts, error traces): retained by default 90 days.
- Opt-outs and controls:
  - No-store/privacy flag: customers can set a per-request or per-API-key flag to prevent storage of prompts/outputs in hosted mode. When enabled, full prompts and outputs are not written to persistent storage; only minimal aggregated metrics are retained.
  - Redaction: we offer an SDK-side redaction helper and a server-side configurable transformer that can strip or mask detected PHI fields before persistence.
  - Dedicated & Private: for Dedicated or Private deployments, customers control retention and residency; default deployments can be configured to retain zero prompts/outputs.
- Data residency & encryption:
  - Residency: Hosted customers may choose region bindings for stored artifacts (us-east1, us-west2, eu-west1). Note: cross-region fallback can be configured for availability - we can lock to US-only for Acme if required.
  - Encryption: TLS in transit; AES-256 at rest. Dedicated/Private supports customer-managed KMS/HSM keys.
- Audit & compliance evidence:
  - SOC2 Type II: summary attached. Full report available under NDA.
  - DPA: standard DPA available; we can provide the signed DPA via procurement.
- Logging/metrics specifics:
  - Token-level data: we do not expose raw token streams in analytics; token counts and aggregated usage metrics are retained. If no-store is enabled, token content is not stored.
  - Billing & troubleshooting: enabling no-store may reduce our ability to reconstruct specific calls for debugging; we provide best-effort support and prioritized remediation for Dedicated customers.

If Acme needs a short, signed statement on company letterhead we can prepare one - happy to produce that after you confirm the exact residency and retention requirements.
